content: Aromatic-carbon anchor worked, so the earlier valence failure was specific to aromatic ring nitrogen. But QED fell 0.671 -> 0.463: the molecule is now 391 Da with 4 aromatic rings, 7 rotatable bonds and LogP 3.77. The culprit is the thioether-benzoxazole arm (atoms 3-12) - a metabolically fragile CH2-S linker plus a whole extra bicycle. Cutting the non-ring CH2-S bond 2-3 removes all ten of those atoms and leaves a simple acetamide, giving N-(3-(pyrimidin-2-ylamino)benzyl)acetamide at ~242 Da: 2 aromatic rings, 3 rotatable bonds, LogP near 1.7. That should put QED back above 0.8 and SA below 2, while the 2-anilinopyrimidine motif - the point of this probe - is exactly what remains.
